name: 3-Body Problem Orbit Physics
description: Watch three massive celestial bodies interact via pure gravitational mathematics. The resulting orbits are inherently chaotic and mathematically unpredictable.

name: 3D Spring Lattice Cube
description: Drag the nodes around! This is a pseudo-3D grid of particles tightly bound by hooke's law spring physics, creating a highly jiggly, stable jello cube.

name: Atomic Attraction Physics
description: A simulation of the Lennard-Jones potential! Particles naturally repel when too close, but attract each other from afar, causing them to clump into digital 'molecules'.

name: Bean Machine Physics
description: Watch physics create mathematical probability! Balls drop through a pegboard, bouncing randomly left and right, naturally forming a perfect Bell Curve.

name: Black Hole Lensing Physics
description: Watch particles shoot past a massive black hole. See how intense gravity warps, bends, and permanently captures their paths.

name: Boids Flocking & Obstacles
description: Watch artificial birds (boids) flock together. Click and drag to draw blue walls on the screen, and watch the flock intelligently split and flow around them!

name: Bouncing Jelly Cube Physics
description: Click anywhere on the screen to toss the cube. It is built out of spring-connected particles, giving it a realistic jello bounce.

name: Bouncing Laser Optics Box
description: Shoot a laser into a perfectly mirrored box. Adjust the entry angle to see how long the mathematical light beam can bounce before hitting the target.

name: Bouncing Polygon Drop Physics
description: Click around the canvas to construct a custom shape. Once closed, the physics engine takes over, calculating gravity and floor bounce for your unique polygon.

name: Buoyancy Physics Simulator
description: Click above the water to drop blocks of different densities. Watch Archimedes' principle in action as heavy blocks sink and light blocks float.

name: Cellular Automata Water Sandbox
description: Draw walls, sand, and water. Watch how the custom algorithms process fluid dynamics, making the water perfectly flow down and fill the containers you build!

name: Cloth & Sphere Physics
description: A heavy cloth drops onto an invisible sphere! Watch the constraint physics mathematically wrap the net smoothly over the ball.

name: Coupled Spring Pendulums
description: Watch energy transfer mathematically between two pendulums! Because they are connected by a spring, one will stop completely to transfer all its momentum to the other, back and forth forever.

name: Domino Chain Physics
description: Drag your mouse to draw a winding path of dominoes. Then click the very first one to trigger the physics-based chain reaction!

name: Double Pendulum Chaos Simulator
description: Watch chaos theory in action. A pendulum attached to another pendulum creates entirely unpredictable, beautiful physics.

name: Double Spring Pendulum
description: A deep simulation of chaotic physics. Two heavy masses are connected by elastic springs instead of rigid rods, creating wildly unpredictable, bouncy orbits.

name: Elastic Pluckable String
description: Drag your mouse through the red line to 'pluck' it. Watch the simulated spring physics propagate the wave back and forth.

name: Elastic Pool Physics Simulator
description: Watch perfectly calculated 2D elastic collisions. The balls bounce, transfer momentum, and conserve energy exactly like real pool balls.

name: Elemental Sand Physics
description: A complex cellular automaton! Draw Sand, Water, Plant, or Fire. Watch gravity pull the sand, water flow, and fire burn the plants!

name: Fluid Dynamics Grid Engine
description: Drag your mouse forcefully to inject dye and velocity into an Eulerian grid fluid simulator. Watch realistic, swirling smoke dynamics.

name: Gravity Orbit Simulator
description: Click and drag to launch planets around the central Sun. Watch Newton's law of universal gravitation in action!

name: Gravity Well Physics Sandbox
description: Click anywhere to place ultra-dense black holes. Then watch how they tear apart and warp the surrounding particle field.

name: Gyroscopic Spinning Top
description: Click to spin the top. Watch the mathematical simulation of gyroscopic precession as the top fights gravity to stay upright!

name: Harmonic Pendulum Wave
description: Viewed from the side, a row of pendulums with perfectly calculated, increasing string lengths swing to form a beautiful snake-like wave pattern.

name: Interactive Gear Train Simulator
description: Adjust the speed of the red driving gear. The math automatically calculates the correct rotational speeds and teeth interlocking for the blue and green driven gears.

name: Interactive Physics Rope
description: Grab the top of the rope with your mouse and swing it back and forth. Watch realistic momentum, gravity, and tension pull the string.

name: Interactive Ragdoll Physics
description: Drag the ragdoll around to watch real-time 'Verlet integration' physics react to gravity, collision, and momentum.

name: Interactive Smoke Fluid Dynamics
description: Drag your mouse forcefully across the canvas to disturb the air and inject colored dye. Simulates real-time fluid diffusion and advection!

name: Interactive Spring Grid
description: Drag the net! Every intersection is connected by simulated elastic springs, creating a jiggly, highly reactive mesh web.

name: Interactive Vector Field
description: A grid of compass needles. Move your mouse over them to push the field and create magnetic ripples.

name: Interactive Water Ripples
description: Move your mouse over the pool to generate realistic, physics-based water ripples and wave reflections.

name: Kepler Solar System Physics
description: Watch the inner planets orbit the sun. Their speeds and elliptical paths are mathematically generated using Johannes Kepler's actual laws of planetary motion.

name: Kinetic Gas Physics
description: Increase the temperature slider to watch the gas particles absorb heat energy, move faster, and bounce aggressively off the walls.

name: Liquid Funnel Sandglass Physics
description: Watch an hourglass simulation. Thousands of physical sand particles collide and funnel perfectly down through the narrow bottleneck.

name: Lorenz Waterwheel Simulator
description: The real-world mechanical model that inspired Chaos Theory! Water fills the buckets from the top. As they get heavy, they spin, creating a mathematically unpredictable, erratic rotation.

name: Magnetic Dipole Field Tracer
description: Observe electromagnetism! A positive and negative magnetic pole naturally curve and bend thousands of floating compass particles along their invisible field lines.

name: Magnetic Pendulum Simulator
description: Release a metallic pendulum over three powerful magnets. Watch it swing wildly until friction forces it to settle on one.

name: Magnetic Repulsion Mesh
description: A web of connected nodes. Your mouse acts as a powerful magnetic repeller. Forcefully push the web apart and watch the physics calculate the tension snap-back!

name: N-Body Gravity Simulator
description: Watch a completely dynamic star cluster simulation where every single particle exerts gravitational pull on every other particle.

name: Newton's Cradle Simulator
description: Watch a seamless, hypnotic simulation of momentum and energy transfer in a classic Newton's Cradle.

name: Optical Prism Simulator
description: Move the laser beam pointer to shoot light into a glass prism. Watch real-time Snell's Law physics accurately refract and split the light!

name: Particle Attractor Physics
description: Click and hold to create a gravitational black hole that attracts all particles. Hold Shift + Click to create a repelling forcefield!

name: Pendulum Wave Illusion
description: Watch 15 uncoupled pendulums swing with slightly different frequencies. Together, they create a mesmerizing snake-like wave illusion.

name: Phantom Traffic Jam Simulator
description: Watch how a single car braking slightly causes a massive, emergent 'phantom' traffic jam behind it due to human reaction times.

name: Projectile Motion Grapher
description: Enter the launch angle and velocity. The tool uses classic kinematic physics equations to perfectly graph the object's parabolic arc.

name: Ragdoll Stair Fall Physics
description: Click to drop a ragdoll dummy down a set of stairs. Uses Verlet integration physics to calculate real-time limb collisions and momentum.

name: Rigid Body Box Stacker
description: Click to drop heavy wooden boxes. A custom Impulse Resolution physics engine accurately calculates their collisions, mass, gravity, and stacking stability.

name: Spring Mass Damper Physics
description: Drag the mass down and release! Adjust the Spring Stiffness and Damping (friction) to see how mechanical shock absorbers work.

name: Squishy Physics Ball
description: A soft-body physics simulation. Grab the ball with your mouse and fling it against the walls to watch it squish and bounce.

name: Tearable Cloth Mesh Simulator
description: A high-performance physics grid. Drag the white nodes to stretch the cloth. Right-click and drag across the mesh to permanently cut and tear the fabric!

name: Vector Flow Field Painter
description: Draw directly on the canvas to paint invisible mathematical 'wind' vectors. Then watch thousands of particles get caught and flow along your custom currents!

name: Verlet Soft Body Car
description: Press Right Arrow to drive! The car is built from points and spring constraints. Watch the soft suspension react to the bumpy procedural terrain.

name: Wave Interference Simulator
description: Watch the mesmerizing mathematical interference patterns generated when two separate expanding wave sources collide.

name: Wind Blown Cloth Simulator
description: A highly optimized Verlet integration net. Adjust the wind slider to watch aerodynamic forces tear and push the fabric.
